method: Scanned paper (no usable text layer): every loaded item compared visually with zoomed crops of the page images of the PDF whose SHA-256 was checked; notation checked against the image. No answer key exists.

source.notes: Genuine one-page school paper 'Grade - IX, Unit Test - II, Physics', M.M. 20, hosted on icseboard.org (school not named; not a CISCE document). No year or duration printed; 2024 comes from the file name, as the pack notes say. Section I prints (5) for five MCQs, Section II prints (15) for 'any three' of five questions; each kept as one entry with its printed group total. All items are from the heat and energy chapter (calorie, energy flow, renewable sources, greenhouse effect, anomalous expansion). Pen ticks ignored. No answer key.

questions.notes: Printed group total (15) for any three of five questions.
